notes_for_editor: Thin record. NHLR is the only tower-specific source: location on SR 20, elevation, registry number, registration date and administrator. The Forest Lookouts page is a stub giving name and county (spelled 'Putnum'). Wikipedia supplies only community context. No build year, designer, staffing, fire history or access information was found. Do not use archive.org item casbcfm_001263 ('Hollister Division of Forestry headquarters', 1956): it is a San Benito County, California photo, a different place. A cached page describing a Hollister fire ('Black Tuesday') has no Florida link and was excluded. Florida Memory item 106202 (Florida Division of Forestry 'fire tower' photo) returned HTTP 403, so it is unread and cannot be used to date the tower. The Scribd history is general context and does not name this tower. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the register never uses the word standing; the story now attributes only the present-tense placement to it.
